gravity.source: Upstream G; also used for legacy mass-equivalent thrust conversion, not exact standard kgf.

tvc_arm.source: apps/python/lqr_compute.py:arm; research assumes pivot at [0,0,+arm] from CoM in FRD.

inertia_zz.source: Need CAD or measurement; do not substitute Ixx.

yaw_accel_per_legacy_mass_equivalent.source: apps/python/lqr_compute.py:B_rz_aero; legacy semantics need bench verification.

yaw_torque_per_differential_thrust.source: Nm/N; rotor reaction torque coefficient has not been identified.

max_total_thrust.source: Measure coaxial assembly at minimum operating battery voltage.

tvc_angle_limit.source: apps/python/lqr_compute.py:u_max[0]; research limit, not verified mechanical stop.

servo_rate_limit.source: Illustrative gimbal output speed, not MG90S specification or measurement.

actuator_study_sample_period.source: Both one-axis example controllers run at 50 Hz; not a firmware scheduler model.

upstream_lqi_cost.source: apps/python/lqr_compute.py:Q12,R; input cost must transform when input units change.
